title: A well-formed URL request whose host and path match no registered decoder is refused, not silently ignored
specRef: docs/url-input-spec-2026-08-13.md §4 «Контракт результату» (D2: refusal must carry a reason)
specNotes: The URL registry (packages/core/decoders/request/index.js) is a documented, closed set of feed signatures (clickunder /feed, authenticated JSON /search and /link — see the existing base pair pop-x-feed-linkfeed-get). This host and path were chosen to be well-formed and address-like (so `looksLikeUrlRequest` recognizes it as an intended feed URL, per docs/url-input-spec-2026-08-13.md D2) while matching none of the three registered decoders' path prefixes.

The product's own documented contract (D2, §4) is that a URL which looks like a feed request but claims no decoder must say so with a reason (`no_decoder`, carrying the parsed protocol/host/pathname/params) rather than being silently accepted or reported as a generic parse failure — this case asserts that documented contract holds, and is a correct-behavior case, not a defect.

Two query parameters (`zone`, `sub`) are present so the `no_decoder` id fires rather than its no-params sibling `request.url.no_decoder_no_params`; the sibling id is asserted absent via mustNot for the same reason.
